name: fee_cap_off_by_one
description: The largest fee is one minor unit too high.

name: fee_just_below_minimum_not_raised
description: A percentage fee exactly one unit below the minimum fee is not raised to the minimum.

name: zero_amount_pays_minimum_fee
description: A zero amount is charged the minimum fee instead of nothing.

name: euro_fee_rounds_half_up
description: Euro fees settle ties half up instead of half to even.

name: negative_amounts_truncate
description: Negative amounts are cut off instead of rounded to the nearest minor unit.

name: yen_has_two_minor_units
description: The yen is converted as if it had two decimal places.

name: quote_fee_uses_source_currency
description: A quote charges the fee under the rules of the source currency instead of the target currency.

name: unknown_target_currency_accepted
description: An unknown target currency silently falls back to the source currency instead of raising an error.

name: fee_larger_than_amount_accepted
description: A quote no longer refuses an amount that does not cover its fee.

name: conversion_ties_use_source_rounding
description: A conversion settles ties by the rounding mode of the source currency instead of the target currency.
